[LOPQ.3.1] **Equality** (`==` / `!=`) is **always available**. It is bytewise on
the representation — reflexive, total, exact, and deterministic — and it is the
routing primitive: an equality join is how a rule matches an opaque value against
an allowlist. An opaque value may be equality-compared only to a value of the
**same** opaque type ([LOPQ.2.3]).
